reviews.t: Not the same as paints pictured
reviews.x: I’m sure the paints are fine, we just received them. Shipping was faster than promised. I was specifically looking for the new rectangular paints that are pictured though. I received the old oval ones. It isn’t worth returning them but was disappointed they were not what was pictured and described!

reviews.t: perfect for kids, no big messes
reviews.x: These paints rock! My girls want to paint all the time and with these water color paints I let them and don't have to worry about a big mess. My girls paint with these nearly every single day. Its a staple in our house.

reviews.t: Item received is not the same as pictured.
reviews.x: According to the picture, I thought I was ordering the 2x paints (more paint) instead I received the normal oval shaped watercolors.

reviews.t: 20% more paint...truth or dare?
reviews.x: During this homeschool adventure (thank you Covid) I decided to be a cooler mom and have a fun art center with water colors and other products. With three kids, the 20% more paint was an obvious choice. What did I get? Standard. nothing extra...Disappointed in crayola for not having a return policy and frustrated that I bothered to pay for the extra paint. Love the product, but disappointed (specially during this time of struggles for the average person) that they can send whatever they want and

reviews.t: Didn’t get what I payed for
reviews.x: This product was supposed to come in a bundle of 4 for $10.00.  When it arrived I only received 1 item inside envelope.  This was for Christmas stocking stuffers for my grandchildren.  Very disappointed.

reviews.t: I own a preschool and this is the best paint. Glad to be able to order the ...
reviews.x: I own a preschool and this is the best paint.  Glad to be able to order the whole set.  Will order again next year.

reviews.t: It's okay not the best
reviews.x: They were okay but some of the color wasn't the brightest and the paint took a while to dry for me.

reviews.t: Purchase 3 packs of 4, received 2 packs of ...
reviews.x: Purchase 3 packs of 4, received 2 packs of 4 and 1 pack of 2.  2 pack even says 4.

reviews.t: Not as advertised, not 2x paint as shown
reviews.x: Not as advertised.  Advertised picture clearly shows as rectangular paint wells, copyright 2019, and x2 amount of paint.  What was received was copyright 2017, oval paint wells, and different labeling.  See attached photos of packaging, paints, and lot numbers.  Therefore what was shipped does not contain the same amount of paint as advertised.  Did not get the amount of product paid for.  Otherwise, product appears genuine Crayola.  Received all 4 sets with 8 colors each, each set with a brush.

reviews.t: Perfect for Youg Kids
reviews.x: A nice set of paints at a good price. Small children love these and they're perfectly adequate for kids up to middle school for craft projects and entertainment painting.  However, these are not for kids who are truly serious about art. Such students should be given artist-quality paints from an art supply store.

reviews.t: Basic watercolors
reviews.x: Obviously these are not professional level watercolors, these are meant for kids. I got the bundle because I have two kids that needed them for school, and they weren't available at my local store. They work for school and I even had an extra to send with both kids.

reviews.t: Just what I remember, easy to use
reviews.x: My 2 1/2 year old grandson and I paint with these paints together. They are just what I remember from childhood, a simple set of 7 colors plus black, that dissolve easily with a little water. Perfect that they are non-toxic.

reviews.t: These are incredible for grownups too!
reviews.x: My kid got these for school but when I used them I loved them so much I bought like 5 more for me too! For some reason everything just turns out prettier with these than when I use regular watercolors :)

reviews.t: Best watercolor for kids
reviews.x: Highly pigmented, reasonably priced, easy to transport. I don't buy any other brand for my kids. I even use these as an adult in a pinch.

reviews.t: Product was in used condition
reviews.x: I’m keeping these Educational watercolors because I like them and they are difficult to find; however, they had clearly been used.

reviews.t: Back to school supplies
reviews.x: Great for back to school supplies, even have some extra I can keep at home!

reviews.t: Great for small children.
reviews.x: For my grandchildren. Love it. Washes off so easy.

reviews.t: Great product and price
reviews.x: Just like I remember. Price and product are great.

reviews.t: great value
reviews.x: I got this as part Of my nephews Christmas gift.

reviews.t: Great for children as well as adults!
reviews.x: These are the best watercolors for children! Although I have professional watercolor sets for my personal use, I often end up using these watercolors to boost or fill in. I am a credentialed Art teacher in the state of CA. I teach K-8 students and these are my go too. Very inexpensive!

reviews.t: False advertising or someone made a mistake and now I can’t return or replace according to Amazon.
reviews.x: This was what I received - not the same product as in the picture of the one I purchased. This one has the oval pans, whereas the rectangular pans have twice as much product and are easier to use with flat brushes. Now, Amazon says I can’t return/exchange!  Not happy.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the product received does not match the pictured or advertised version, citing different paint well shapes and missing the promised extra paint.
Several reviewers report receiving the wrong quantity or incomplete bundles, such as fewer packs or items than ordered.
Reviewers frequently praise these watercolors as great for young kids, easy to use, and good for mess-free everyday painting.
Some reviewers note the paints are basic rather than professional quality, with some colors not very bright and slow drying.
A few reviewers mention receiving items in used condition or being disappointed with the seller's return policy.
